about_the_game:
• Currently only the first half of Episode 1 is available to play.
  • The full Vacation Special will consist of 3 Episodes in total.

A year after the epic conclusion of Motherless, the saga continues in a thrilling new chapter. Join Sunny, the 26-year-old head of the world’s most powerful family, as he embarks on a steamy and suspenseful getaway that will test his charm, wit, and courage.



Step into paradise with the Vacation Special, where desire meets danger. Sunny, now basking in his hard-earned legacy, invites six breathtaking women—handpicked by our passionate community—to join him for an unforgettable vacation on a secluded island. Expect hot encounters and heartfelt moments as you navigate the mysterious island, each character bringing her own fiery passion to the shore.



But this isn’t just a carefree escape. When an unexpected twist leaves the group stranded, the island’s serene beauty begins to unravel. As the young patriarch, your actions will shape not only the steamy connections with your companions but also the path to uncovering the island’s hidden truths. Can you keep the group united?



Motherless - Vacation Special blends the seductive charm of the original Motherless with a pulse-pounding mix of suspense and mystery. This DLC delivers explicit romance, deep character interactions, and a gripping storyline that will keep you guessing.



Are you ready to lead with passion and unravel the island’s secrets? Motherless - Vacation Special invites you to dive into a world of lust, loyalty, and lurking danger. Grab your spot on this exclusive getaway—paradise awaits, but so does the unknown.

Note: This DLC requires the base game Motherless to play. Contains mature themes and explicit content suitable for adults only.

content_descriptors.notes:
MOTHERLESS is a Visual Novel (VN) for adults with explicit sex scenes. Not intended for audiences under 18 years old.

The game graphically depicts alcohol, the use of violence and drug references. If you are easily offended, this one is not for you.

All sex in the game is consensual and all characters are over 18 years old.
